McpServerDefinition.description: Zenthera Patient Support Program (demo, fictional data): answers program questions from the PSP Program FAQ (Data 360 data library).

tools.descriptionOverride: Read-only. Answers a question about the Zenthera Patient Support Program (demo, fictional) using only the Program FAQ document: eligibility, enrollment, copay and insurance support, uninsured help, prior authorization, shipments and refills, contact hours, privacy and leaving the program. Input: question (the user's words). Returns resultCode (SUCCESS, VALIDATION_ERROR, ERROR), answer (show to the user as written, including its Source line) and resultMessage. If the FAQ has no answer it says so; never add facts that are not in the answer. Gives no medical advice: dosing and side effect questions go to the prescriber. Not for patient records: use the patient profile or refill tools for those.
